rows.question: How do I control grass weeds in a paddy nursery?
rows.query_en: How do I control grass weeds in a paddy nursery?
rows.answer: Mechanical transplanting with a paddy transplanter should be followed by interculture with a Paddy Weeder 15 days after transplanting and again after a fortnight. If a paddy weeder cannot be run, hand weeding may be done. Chemical weed control with pre-emergence and early post-emergence herbicides is also an option.
rows.answer_en: Mechanical transplanting with a paddy transplanter should be followed by interculture with a Paddy Weeder 15 days after transplanting and again after a fortnight [1]. If a paddy weeder cannot be run, hand weeding may be done. Chemical weed control with pre-emergence and early post-emergence herbicides is also an option [1].

rows.question: How much zinc sulphate should I apply to transplanted paddy for zinc deficiency?
rows.query_en: How much zinc sulphate should I apply to transplanted paddy for zinc deficiency?
rows.answer: Apply 25 kg of zinc sulphate heptahydrate (21%) or 16 kg zinc sulphate monohydrate (33%) per acre at puddling if the previous crop in the field had shown symptoms of zinc deficiency.

rows.question: How much urea does direct-seeded rice need and when?

rows.answer: Apply 130 kg urea per acre in three equal splits at 4, 6 and 9 weeks of sowing for direct-seeded rice. The urea dose can be reduced to 90 kg per acre after green manuring with sunnhemp or FYM application @ 6 tonne per acre, or if summer moong residue has been incorporated after picking pods.

rows.question: What is the right time to sow kharif maize in Punjab?
rows.query_en: What is the right time to sow kharif maize in Punjab?
rows.answer: The right time to sow kharif maize in Punjab is from the last week of May to the end of June. For fields prone to water stagnation, sowing should be done by the end of May to early June to ensure the crop gets firmly established before the rains.

rows.question: Should I spray synthetic pyrethroids on cotton early in the season?
rows.query_en: Should I spray synthetic pyrethroids on cotton early in the season?
rows.answer: No, for early sown crops (first fortnight of April), synthetic pyrethroids should not be used as the initial spray against pink bollworm. Instead, the first spray should be given when 10-20 per cent plants start producing squares, particularly in fields near cotton sticks or ginning mills.

rows.question: क्या कपास पर मौसम की शुरुआत में सिंथेटिक पायरेथ्रॉइड का छिड़काव करना चाहिए?
rows.query_en: Should synthetic pyrethroids be sprayed on cotton at the beginning of the season?
rows.answer: गुलाबी और धब्बेदार कीड़ों को नियंत्रित करने के लिए मौसम की शुरुआत में सिंथेटिक पायरेथ्रोइड्स का छिड़काव नहीं किया जाना चाहिए । परिच्छेद के अनुसार गुलाबी बोलवर्म के खिलाफ पहला छिड़काव तब किया जाना चाहिए जब 10 - 20 प्रतिशत पौधे वर्ग का उत्पादन करना शुरू कर दें, विशेष रूप से कपास स्टिक या जिनिंग मिलों से सटे खेतों में ।
rows.answer_en: No, synthetic pyrethroids should not be sprayed at the beginning of the season for controlling pink and spotted bollworms. According to passage [1], the first spray against pink bollworm should be done when 10-20 per cent plants start producing squares, particularly in fields adjoining cotton sticks or ginning mills.

rows.question: పత్తిపై సీజన్ మొదట్లో సింథటిక్ పైరిత్రాయిడ్ పిచికారీ చేయవచ్చా?

rows.answer: సింథటిక్ పైరెత్రాయిడ్లను సీజన్ ప్రారంభంలో పత్తిలో చల్లకూడదు. పింక్ మరియు మచ్చల బోల్వార్మ్లను నియంత్రించడానికి డానితోల్ / మీథ్రిన్ మరియు ఫాస్టాక్ / ఆల్ఫాగౌర్డ్ / మెరిట్ వంటి సింథటిక్ పైరెథ్రోయిడ్లను ఉపయోగించాలి, అయితే 10 - 20 శాతం మొక్కలు ముఖ్యంగా పత్తి కర్రలు లేదా జిన్నింగ్ మిల్లుల సమీపంలోని పొలాల్లో చతురస్రాలను ఉత్పత్తి చేయడం ప్రారంభించినప్పుడు మొదటి స్ప్రే ఇవ్వాలి.
rows.answer_en: No, synthetic pyrethroids should not be sprayed early in the season on cotton. According to passage [1], synthetic pyrethroids like Danitol/Meothrin and Fastac/Alphagaurd/Merit should be used to control pink and spotted bollworms, but the first spray should be given when 10-20 per cent plants start producing squares, particularly in fields near cotton sticks or ginning mills.

rows.question: How can I reduce pink bollworm carry-over in cotton?
rows.query_en: How can I reduce pink bollworm carry-over in cotton?
rows.answer: To reduce pink bollworm carry-over in cotton, apply 125 g per application per acre of gossyplure 4% (7, 11 Hexadecadienyl acetate) for mating disruption. Additionally, use Sticka/Delta traps with at least 10 micro litre of gossyplure and place one trap per hectare at 15 cm above the crop canopy, replacing the lure every 15 days.
rows.answer_en: To reduce pink bollworm carry-over in cotton, apply 125 g per application per acre of gossyplure 4% (7, 11 Hexadecadienyl acetate) for mating disruption. Additionally, use Sticka/Delta traps with at least 10 micro litre of gossyplure and place one trap per hectare at 15 cm above the crop canopy, replacing the lure every 15 days [3].

rows.question: कपास में गुलाबी सुंडी को अगले मौसम तक पहुँचने से कैसे रोकें?
rows.query_en: How to prevent the pink sundae in cotton from reaching the next season?
rows.answer: गुलाबी कीड़ा को अगले मौसम तक पहुंचने से रोकने के लिए किसानों को अप्रैल में लगातार 3 - 4 दिनों तक बीज को बुआई करने से पहले एसिड - डिलिन्ट करना चाहिए या धूप में अच्छी तरह से सुखाना चाहिए । इसके अतिरिक्त उन्हें बुवाई के लिए बीज रखने से बचना चाहिए और इसके बजाय इसे मवेशियों को खिलाना चाहिए ।
rows.answer_en: To prevent the pink bollworm from reaching the next season, farmers should acid-delint the seed before sowing or thoroughly dry it in the sun for 3-4 consecutive days in April [1, 3]. Additionally, they should avoid retaining seed for sowing and instead feed it to cattle [1].

rows.question: పత్తిలో గులాబీ రంగు కాయ తొలుచు పురుగు తర్వాతి సీజన్‌కు రాకుండా ఎలా ఆపాలి?
rows.query_en: How to stop the pink leaf borer in cotton from coming in the next season?
rows.answer: To prevent the pink bollworm from coming in the next season, farmers should acid-delint or thoroughly dry the seed in the sun for 3-4 consecutive days in April [1, 3]. Additionally, fumigate the seed left uncrushed in the mills before the end of April with Celphos/Phostoxin/Delicia @ one 3-g tablet per cubic metre space, giving an exposure of 48 hours or use two tablets with an exposure of 24 hours [4].
rows.answer_en: To prevent the pink bollworm from coming in the next season, farmers should acid-delint or thoroughly dry the seed in the sun for 3-4 consecutive days in April [1, 3]. Additionally, fumigate the seed left uncrushed in the mills before the end of April with Celphos/Phostoxin/Delicia @ one 3-g tablet per cubic metre space, giving an exposure of 48 hours or use two tablets with an exposure of 24 hours [4].
